title: RSS, sitemap, robots.txt

title: Django project scaffold: venv, settings, AbstractUser
description: Django project via startproject blog_project, startapp blog. Single app with CustomUser. At start: generate short random BLOG_TITLE (cakeipsum), add to settings, use in templates. Settings: env-based overrides for base/dev/prod. SQLite 3, AUTH_USER_MODEL, migrations. Django 6.x. Runs in integration-test blog subdir.

title: Posts app: model, list/detail views, templates
description: Post, Category, Comment models. Post: status (draft/published), created_at and published_at both auto_now_add=True; slug globally unique (update-2, update-3); Category FK nullable, default Uncategorized. Post CRUD: Django admin only. Post URL: /post/YYYY-MM-DD/slug (date from published_at, SEO only; resolve by slug). Front page at / only; category filter at /category/<slug>/. Comments: plain text (no rich editor); form below post content; line breaks → HTML paragraphs when displayed; shown immediately; admins can delete. Tests: 90%+ coverage. No JS.

title: User auth: registration, login, logout
description: Registration (built-in forms), login, logout. Login redirect to home. Disable email verification if possible; otherwise mock — no human-in-the-loop. Permission model: new users = read-only + submit comments; superuser only for post CRUD, user admin.

title: Integration test runner: full flow, verify
description: Integration test runner: hands-off. Create GitHub repo (API/CLI) at start; add CI workflow (trigger on push to main). Two-phase: (1) MVP: scripted steps per bead. (2) Production: full agentic workflow. Per bead: commit substantial chunks; push when done; check CI, fix errors. Report timing (per commit, test round, fix, bead, epic) and tokens (best available) to integration-test-metrics.json and .md. Final: manage.py check, full test suite.

title: Front page: most recent posts
description: Front page at /. Only post list (no /posts/). Most recent posts, published only. Paginated. Server-rendered. No JS. Run: uv run manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8765.

title: Minimal styling: modern theme, system fonts
description: Base template (layout, nav, footer). Use FOSS template or guide; customize. CSS for all pages (front, posts, pages, auth). Modern, minimal, system fonts. No JS.

title: Pages app: static pages (About, etc.)
